index.title: Client onboarding
index.subtitle: Set up a new client step by step across all systems.

startNew.title: Start new onboarding
startNew.description: Set up a new client from scratch across all systems.

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: View, continue or start each client. Progress is determined from the IDs stored in the respective services.

detail.notFoundDescription: The requested client no longer exists.

completedBanner.title: Onboarding completed
completedBanner.description: All steps were completed successfully. You can still select any step to review the stored information.

directus.title: ONE
directus.description: Create a new client and users in the Directus instance.
directus.intro: Create a new client record and one or more user accounts in Directus.

jira.title: Jira
jira.description: Set up a new Jira project for the medium.
jira.intro: Create a new Jira project with the «Default Media Workflow» workflow scheme and configure the board.
jira.directusRequired: Step 1 (Directus) must be completed first so the client record can be updated after the project is created.
jira.projectKeyHint: Max. 10 characters, uppercase letters and numbers only
jira.leadHint: Jira account ID is set automatically

invite.heading: Invite users
invite.teamDescription: Select existing Jira users — they get full admin access to the project.
invite.customerDescription: External customers: if no Jira account exists yet, an invitation is sent by email.

validation.nameAndKeyRequired: Project name and project key are required.
validation.teamRequired: Please select at least one team user.
validation.customerEmailRequired: Please enter at least one customer email.

slack.title: Slack
slack.description: Create a dedicated Slack channel for the client.
slack.intro: Create a dedicated Slack channel for the client.
slack.adminOnly: Only administrators can perform this step.

bexio.title: Bexio
bexio.description: Register the new client in Bexio as a contact / customer.
bexio.intro: Register the new client in Bexio as a company contact. The Bexio contact ID is saved automatically on the client record and is needed for later invoicing.
bexio.directusRequired: Step 1 (Directus) must be completed first so the client record can be updated after creation.
bexio.savedOnClient: — was saved on the client record.
bexio.emailHint: Stored as the contact's primary email address
bexio.allFieldsRequired: All fields (company name, email, street, no., ZIP, city) are required.

clockodo.title: Clockodo
clockodo.description: Connect the Bexio customer to Clockodo.
clockodo.intro: Connect the Bexio customer to Clockodo so hours can be tracked and billed correctly. The Clockodo Bexio integration automatically syncs Bexio contacts as Clockodo customers.
clockodo.bexioRequired: Step 4 (Bexio) must be completed first before the Clockodo sync can be performed.
clockodo.savedOnClient: — was saved on the client record.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Set up the editor and website environment for the client.

manualTasks.title: Manual steps
manualTasks.description: Work through the manual tasks per the checklist.
manualTasks.intro: The following tasks must be done manually. Tick off each task once it's complete. The linked guide describes each step in detail.
manualTasks.allDone: All manual tasks are done. You can finish the step.

jiraBoardSetup.title: Set up Jira board
jiraBoardSetup.description: Add custom columns to the Jira board and assign them to the corresponding task states.

slackInvites.title: Slack invitations
slackInvites.description: Invite users to the dedicated Slack channel and #we-share.

invoicing.title: Invoice
invoicing.description: Create the first invoices for hosting and onboarding.
invoicing.intro: Create the first invoice for hosting (from the start of development) and the one-off onboarding invoice. Check each one off once it has been created in Bexio.
invoicing.allDone: Both invoices have been created. You can complete this step.

period.label: Billing period
period.hint: Choose the period to bill against.
period.none: No billing period for this client yet.
period.noDefinitions: No period definitions available. Create a period in Directus first.

hostingInvoice.title: Create hosting invoice
hostingInvoice.description: Recurring hosting invoice from the start of development. In "Create Bexio invoice", "Hosting" tab.

email.title: Email
email.description: Send a summary email with all credentials.
email.intro: The text below is pre-filled from the previous steps. Adjust it if needed, then copy it and send it from your mail client.
email.subject: Subject
email.notImplemented: Automatic email sending is not implemented. Copy the text and send it from your mail client to {recipient}.

welcome.subject: Welcome to We.Publish – your most important links
welcome.intro: great to have you on board at We.Publish! So you can get started right away, here are the four platforms we work with – each with a clear purpose, so you always know where to find what:
welcome.oneText: Here you can see at any time how many hours we've worked for you, what's on your balance, your contract and all invoices. Full transparency over the costs.
welcome.jiraText: Your project board: here we track all tasks, bugs and features. You can check at any time what we're working on, comment on tickets or submit new requests.
welcome.slackText: For quick contact: questions, coordination and direct exchange with the team – faster and more personal than email.
welcome.editorText: Your editorial cockpit: maintain articles, pages and content of your website as well as manage subscribers and CRM.
welcome.summary: In short: ONE for finances, Jira for project work, Slack for communication and the Editor for your content. That way everything stays in its place.
welcome.activateOutro: Via the link above (ONE) you activate your account and set your password. You can then invite further team members at any time – log in to ONE and open the “Team” section.
welcome.meeting: In the next few days we'll get in touch with you to arrange a date for an in-person meeting – so we can get to know each other in peace and discuss the next steps together.
welcome.closing:
See you soon and best regards
Your We.Publish team
